summary: American Healthcare REIT filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a new at-the-market equity program of up to $1.75 billion of common stock, replacing a prior February 27, 2026 sales agreement under which roughly $1.58 billion had already been sold. Agents include BofA, Citigroup, Citizens JMP, Credit Agricole, Fifth Third, KeyBanc, Morgan Stanley, RBC, Regions and Truist; forward-sale counterparts are also contemplated. Shares trade on NYSE as AHR, closing at $56.04 on November 5, 2026, with a 9.9% ownership limit. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation. Watch dilution pace and forward-settlement overhang.
